algebraic_rows.locality_or_isotony_rule: Declare the reconstructed algebra explicitly, including direct-sum factor blocks, commutative center, whether off-diagonal sector coherence is observable, and the one fixed boundary carrier region/algebraic inclusion. Test approximate operator-algebra recovery with the complementary defect ||Nhat-Nhat o P_{A'}||_diamond under an arbitrary external reference and identify one common CPTP decoder; if only state-level residuals are available, declare total code/reference dimension and the complete-boundedness lift.
algebraic_rows.type_or_topology_pressure: Identify whether the algebra is treated as type-I tensor-factor-like, type-III local-QFT-like, type-II/crossed-product-like, finite benchmark algebra, commutative likelihood algebra, or unspecified; cap Hilbert-space-factorization language when algebra type, closure, topology, or quotient is not declared.
algebraic_rows.algebraic_failure_mode: Failure can appear as assuming a tensor factor where only a von Neumann algebra exists, auditing only the center while factor-block modular transport diverges, demanding off-diagonal sector coherence from a direct-sum algebra that excludes it, hiding sector-conditioned frame information from a common decoder, averaging away a rare bad sector, treating a gauge-fixed representative as invariant, or mistaking metadata namespaces for physical algebras.
algebraic_rows.algebraic_test: Hold one fixed carrier and target algebra while varying sector weights, factor frames, routing confusion, state pairs, and an entangled external reference. Evaluate the complementary-channel diamond/cb commutant defect, one common decoder, center transport, factor-block log transport, worst-sector instrument error, and—only when declared—cross-sector coherence recovery.
algebraic_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer local subsystem, tensor-factor, split-property, local entropy, public-record completeness, or candidate-native observable support from algebraic vocabulary unless factorization and edge/center rows also pass.
